about.title: About DappleByte
about.description: DappleByte is an independent studio building Android apps: no ads, no subscriptions, no server between you and your hardware, source published under AGPL-3.0.
about.whatBody: DappleByte is an independent studio building Android apps. One developer, a small number of apps, each one meant to do a specific job well and then stay out of the way.
about.openSourceBody: Every release of every app is published as source code under the AGPL-3.0. The repository link is on each app's page. You can read exactly what the app does, build it yourself, or check that the privacy policy matches the code.
about.contactBody: Studio, press and partnerships: {email}. Support for a specific app goes to the address on that app's support page, so it reaches the right inbox with the right context.
about.trademarksBody: Product names of other companies appear on this site only to describe what our apps work with. They belong to their owners, and no affiliation or endorsement is implied.
about.siteBody: Static HTML built with Astro and hosted on GitHub Pages. It sets no cookies and loads no third-party scripts. The site's own source is public at github.com/dapplebyte/dapplebyte.github.io.

faq.notFoundBody: Write to us with your phone model, your console and what happened. A person reads every message.

support.title: {name} support
support.description: Get help with {name}: what to check first, how to write to us, what to include, and how refunds work.
beforeItems: Open the FAQ. Most connection, sign-in and picture questions are answered there, with the same wording as in the app.
If the app can't connect, run Connection Doctor from Settings. It checks your network, the console and Remote Play, and it can email the report to us with one tap.
Make sure the console is on or in rest mode with Remote Play turned on in its settings.
support.writeBody: The button opens your mail app with the subject filled in. If nothing opens, copy the address and the checklist below into any email.
support.subject: [{name}]

template.where: At home or away from home:
template.doctor: If you ran Connection Doctor, paste the report here.

support.refundBody: If {name} doesn't work with your setup, email us within 7 days of purchase and we'll refund it. Tell us what you tried; it helps us fix it for the next person.
support.replyBody: Usually within two working days. Every message is read by a person, and every message gets an answer.

privacy.title: {name} privacy policy
privacy.description: What {name} for Android does with your data: no account, no server of ours, what stays on the device, and where the app connects.
privacy.appliesTo: Applies to {name} for Android ({appId}), distributed on Google Play.
privacy.governing: This policy is published in English. Translations, when available, are for convenience only; the English text governs.

sitePrivacy.title: Website privacy
sitePrivacy.description: dapplebyte.com sets no cookies, runs no analytics and loads no third-party scripts.
items: This website is static HTML. It sets no cookies and loads no third-party scripts, fonts or analytics.
We do not run analytics here. Our only numbers come from Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools, which report search impressions in aggregate.
If you email us, we keep the message as long as needed to help you, then delete it. We do not add you to any list.
The site is hosted on GitHub Pages, which logs requests the way any web server does. See GitHub's privacy statement for details.
Each app has its own privacy policy, linked from its page. Those policies cover what the apps do; this page only covers the website.
